description: This file defines the PagerManager class in Drupal, responsible for managing pager instances, caching, and generating pagination parameters.

classes.name: PagerManager
classes.description: A class that manages pager instances, including creation, retrieval, and parameter updates within Drupal.

methods.name: createPager
methods.description: Creates a new Pager object with specified total, limit, and element, and caches it.

methods.name: getPager
methods.description: Retrieves a cached Pager object by its element index.

methods.name: findPage
methods.description: Finds the current page number for a given pager ID.

methods.name: getUpdatedParameters
methods.description: Builds and returns updated query parameters for pagination, merging current request parameters.

methods.name: getMaxPagerElementId
methods.description: Returns the highest pager element ID used so far.

methods.name: reservePagerElementId
methods.description: Reserves a new pager element ID, updating the maximum if necessary.

methods.name: setPager
methods.description: Stores a Pager object in the static cache under a specific element index.
